$comment: Hand-written record of where the vendored files of docs/claims/vendor/ came from and of the vulnerability check (#49). tools/build_claims_viewer.py copies it into docs/claims/vendor/MANIFEST.json. Update it whenever a version changes.

pyodide.source_sha256_from: the digest of the release asset (gh api repos/pyodide/pyodide/releases/tags/314.0.8), equal to the sha256 of the downloaded file
pyodide.packages_source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/pyodide/v314.0.8/full/<file name> (downloaded once at build time; each wheel's sha256 equals the sha256 of pyodide-lock.json, which Pyodide checks again when it loads the wheel)

method: OSV querybatch (https://api.osv.dev/v1/querybatch) for every npm package of tools/claims_editor_vendor/package-lock.json (bundled and dev), npm pyodide 314.0.8, and the PyPI packages of the vendored wheels at their versions
GitHub security advisories of pyodide/pyodide (gh api repos/pyodide/pyodide/security-advisories) and the GitHub advisory database for npm pyodide (gh api advisories?ecosystem=npm&affects=pyodide)
check.result: no known vulnerability: OSV returned no advisory for any of the 57 package versions (47 npm in the lock file, npm pyodide, 9 PyPI), npm audit found 0 vulnerabilities, and pyodide has no published security advisory
check.not_covered: CPython 3.14.2 inside Pyodide (python_stdlib.zip) is not a package of OSV's PyPI ecosystem and was not checked by version; the editor runs only claim_lint on files the reader opened, in the browser sandbox, with no network beyond this site (CSP connect-src 'self')
